source.prompt: Original instrumental title music for a dark borderland folk mystery, intimate and patient, human warmth held against an uncertain road. A memorable rising three-note protective-bell motif is answered by a low bowed viola melody over dry plucked cittern and wooden frame-drum taps. Small acoustic string ensemble, breathy wooden flute used sparingly, resonant iron bells rather than bright glockenspiel. Begin with the plucked road figure already moving, introduce the viola theme, broaden gently into interwoven strings and a measured walking pulse, then return to the spare opening texture with the pulse still alive. Weathered wood, bow grain, natural room air, restrained low end, warm close recording, wide but coherent stereo, generous melodic breathing room. Entirely instrumental, no voice or choir, no electronic dance beat, no trailer impacts. End on a sustained open fifth with continuous plucked motion suitable for a clean loop.

source.prompt: Original instrumental epilogue for Three Bells: border villages restore shared protection after a costly journey. Three different warm iron bells answer each other over dry cittern arpeggios and a tender bowed viola melody. Small acoustic folk string ensemble, low cello, very soft brushed frame drum, a little wooden flute. The familiar rising three-note shelter motif now resolves into a modest warm major harmony. Begin quietly, let the instruments answer as neighbours rather than a grand orchestra, open into one restrained luminous statement, then let percussion fall away and close with an unhurried resolved strings-and-bell cadence and complete natural decay. Weathered intimate recording, relief with remembered loss, never triumphalist. Entirely instrumental, no singing or choir.

source.description: Wet pasture wind, distant small iron door bells, wooden wagon creaks.
Forest canopy and orchard leaves, sparse small birds, branch creaks.
Reed hiss, black-water laps and drips, damp plank and ferry-rope creaks.
Layered brine surf, sand hiss, rigging wood and distant shore birds.
Dry exposed gusts, granular ash, charcoal ticks and hollow loose slag.
Sheltered low wind, distant bronze foundry work and army wagon wood.
Cold mountain gusts, snow hiss, dry shelter timber and distant monastery bell.
Hushed fir wind, loose shutters at a stone well, sparse deep water drops; no voices.
Bow-limb flex, string release and narrow arrow air pass.
Sword air sweep with a short steel hilt ring.
Heavy cleave air displacement and rough iron scrape.
Muted layered leather/cloth body impact, no vocalization.
Equipment settles: cloth fall, wood thump and small loose iron.
Leather pouch lift and several small coin contacts.
Three warm protective bell answers and a wooden latch.
Two grain sacks set onto a wooden wagon deck, grain rattle.
Wagon board crack, loose wheel wood and falling cargo.
Axle creak, two wheel bumps and leather harness jostle.
Three different hammer-on-wood strikes and tightened rope.
Dry plucked-string ascending figure, small bronze confirmation.
Layered three-arrow volley with a flutter of dry leaves.
Broad shield-plate strike and protective iron resonance.
Double heavy cleave and deep leather-frame impact.
Single heavy foundry bell with irregular bronze partials.
Restrained rising three-bell cadence with dry plucked strings.
Low descending muted strings and a final dull wood contact.
Short double wooden mechanism contact.
Soft heel thump followed by granular earth and leather scuff.
Hard heel and toe contacts with a short stone reflection.
Cloth rush, leather flex and a restrained earth slide.
Open resonant glass and a dry plucked questioning figure.
Parchment unfolding, wood edge contact, quiet glass detail.
